caption: A lidded plastic container of leftovers is heated in a microwave, and the lid domes upward and pops loose.

sa.check: A plastic container with its lid on sits in a microwave.
The lid lifts at one corner.
A puff of steam escapes as the lid lifts.
The doming comes first and the popping loose follows.

pc.expect: The dome only grows while the food heats and the lid does not sink back before it lifts.
pc.fail: The dome sinks inward while the microwave runs; or the dome grows and shrinks in turn; or the lid domes before the microwave has started; or the lid lifts, re-seats itself and domes again.

pc.expect: The lid stays one lid whose flat top bows upward and springs back or hangs loose once it lifts.
pc.fail: The lid keeps a perfectly flat top while plainly lifting at its rim; or the lid swells into a balloon much larger than the container; or the lid splits into pieces; or the lid turns into another object.

pc.expect: The dome bulges upward rather than downward, and the lid falls back onto the container or lies on it once loose.
pc.fail: The lid bows downward into the food; or the loose lid rises and hangs above the container; or the lid flies up and sticks to the microwave's roof; or the food climbs the container's wall and stays.

pc.expect: The food shows the heating: it steams or bubbles, and the steam escapes where the lid lifts.
pc.fail: The lid domes while the food below is still with no steam at all; or the steam escapes from the container's base; or the lid lifts and no steam or movement shows in the food to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: One container with one lid; the lid stays a separate piece and the food stays inside.
pc.fail: The lid merges into the container's rim; or a second lid appears; or food passes through the container's wall; or the container vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The container's colour, the food's look and the microwave's interior stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the food changes into something else; or the interior changes.
